title: Crispy Canadian Corn Tostada
description: A crunchy and flavorful Mexican-inspired dish featuring Canadian corn, topped with warm, crispy elements.
instructions: Bake the tomatoes for 15 minutes or until tender.
Cook the bacon in a pan until crispy.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Grill or cook the Canadian corn until lightly charred.
Assemble the tostadas by placing a warm tortilla on a plate, topping with a spoonful of Canadian corn, a few pieces of crispy bacon, some diced onions, and a sprinkle of cheese.
Drizzle with sour cream and garnish with chopped cilantro.
